chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: He means Mu‘āwiyah and his men.

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الشَّرِيفُ: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī, the compiler of Nahj al-Balagha
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةَ: Mu‘āwiyah ibn Abi Sufyan, the Umayyad caliph

ai.seo_question: Who does As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī identify as the referent in this passage from Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi explicitly identifies the referent as Mu‘āwiyah ibn Abi Sufyan and his companions, anchoring the text in the Umayyad era of Shia historiography. This clarification highlights the specific political and theological opposition faced by the Ahl al-Bayt, distinguishing the Umayyad leadership from other contemporary factions. The identification serves to contextualize the subsequent command regarding the Kharijites within the broader narrative of early Islamic civil strife (Fitna).
